summary: Telecom Argentina S.A. filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited condensed consolidated financial statements and operating/financial review as of March 31, 2026. This is a routine periodic report required of foreign private issuers under SEC Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16, not a special-situation event. The filing includes standard financial disclosures, notes, and definitions of terms, with no mention of any acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. As a routine earnings release, it falls outside all special-situations categories. The filing is solely a financial update for the period ended March 31, 2026.
